purpose: Paperclip upgrade backup proof (T02/T06 reconciled). Target identity bound to companion upgrade-contract.json. HONEST FAIL-CLOSED STATE: backup_verified=false because no DB dump, volume snapshot, or config hash was actually captured in this slice (auto-mode execution lane, no VPS SSH per LFP-S02-01). Placeholder volume_snapshot_ids, db_dump_id, and config_hash fields are template strings only — actual backup requires user-confirmed execution. Validator V-UP-R09 will trigger honestly; this artifact documents the actual state, not a forced PASS.
backup_classification_rationale: T02 backup proof is the deterministic function f(db_dump_performed, volume_snapshot_performed, config_hash_captured, integrity_verified) → BLOCKED. With db_dump_performed=false, volume_snapshot_performed=false, config_hash_captured=false, and integrity_verified=false (auto-mode, no VPS access), backup_verified=true would constitute evidence laundering. The accurate description of state at T06 is: 'target identity bound to upgrade contract, but no actual backup was captured'. The target_revision and target_commit_sha fields remain bound to upgrade-contract.json identity (replay guard per V-UP-R08); only backup_verified=false honestly reflects the absent work.

target_identity_provenance.policy: Bound to upgrade-contract.json target identity. Drift on this is V-UP-R08 (backup target identity mismatch) or V-UP-R02/R03 (cross-contract mismatch).

fresh_backup_blockers.blocker: auto-mode execution lane; no human on call to confirm a VPS SSH cycle for DB dump / volume snapshot / config hash capture per LFP-S02-01
fresh_backup_blockers.rule_reference: LFP-S02-01 inherited from S02 forensic verdict

fresh_backup_blockers.blocker: no authenticated access to Postgres or Docker on the VPS; even a read-only snapshot requires either (a) user-confirmed SSH tunnel to 127.0.0.1:3131, or (b) user-confirmed Postgres read role, both of which require explicit human confirmation
fresh_backup_blockers.rule_reference: LFP-S02-01 + LFP-S02-02 (no destructive docker command in auto-mode)

backup_verification_blockers.blocker: no DB dump was performed (pg_dump / pg_dumpall not executed); no volume snapshot was performed (docker volume snapshot not executed); no config hash was computed (sha256sum not run against /opt/paperclip-sandbox or nginx reverse-proxy config); backup_verified=false is the honest state
backup_verification_blockers.rule_reference: validator V-UP-R09 requires backup_verified=true once DB dump checksum + volume snapshot ID + config hash are captured AND integrity-checked; absent capture → false

backup_methodology_intent: When a fresh backup is performed (user-confirmed): (1) pg_dump paperclip_production > /opt/backups/paperclip-preupgrade-TIMESTAMP.sql then sha256sum the dump; (2) docker run --rm -v paperclip_sandbox_paperclip-data:/data busybox tar czf /opt/backups/paperclip-data-TIMESTAMP.tar.gz -C /data . then snapshot the volume; (3) sha256sum /opt/paperclip-sandbox/docker-compose.sandbox-override.yml /etc/nginx/sites-available/paperclip.oysana.com.conf; (4) record volume_snapshot_ids[], db_dump_id, config_hash; (5) integrity_check: re-hash dump + config, compare against captured values; only then set backup_verified=true.

components_intended_to_backup.intended_method: pg_dump via SSH tunnel to 127.0.0.1:3131 (not executed)
docker volume snapshot via SSH tunnel (not executed)

components_intended_to_backup.component: Paperclip .env secrets at /opt/paperclip-sandbox/.env (NEVER echoed, hashed only)
components_intended_to_backup.intended_method: sha256sum over SSH tunnel; only hash returned, never content (not executed)
components_intended_to_backup.redaction_note: .env secrets are NEVER captured or echoed in this artifact or any downstream evidence. hash-only capture preserves the integrity guarantee without disclosure.

integrity_check_methodology_intent: After capture, integrity verification consists of: (a) re-reading the DB dump and confirming its sha256 matches the captured db_dump_id; (b) re-listing the volume snapshot and confirming its volume_snapshot_ids; (c) re-reading the config files and confirming sha256 matches captured config_hash; (d) cross-check: the three values agree with their originally captured values within the same backup window. Integrity verification only succeeds if all four checks agree.
rollback_continuity_intent: Once backup is captured, the rollback evidence in runtime-evidence/M014-S04-paperclip-rollback.json MUST inherit (a) previous_image_digest from a captured container image digest (sha256:... prefix acceptable) taken before mutation, (b) previous_config_hash from the same captured config_hash above. Rollback continuity is NOT verified in this slice because no backup was captured; rollback evidence carries BLOCKED_NO_DEPLOY placeholders to maintain chain consistency with this artifact.

fail_closed_blockers.blocker: backup_verified=false — honest because no DB dump / volume snapshot / config hash was actually captured in this slice (FRB-T02-BACKUP-01, FRB-T02-BACKUP-02)

diagnostics.verify_no_secrets: REDACTION_FORBIDDEN_SUBSTRINGS scan enforced by validator V-UP-R10. This artifact is free of credential key=value patterns and full UUID literals. All credentials would be hash-only in a real backup proof; this artifact's placeholders use the constant BLOCKED_NO_BACKUP_CAPTURED to indicate absence of capture.

anti_replay.policy: snapshot bound to upgrade-contract.json target identity; replay guard is target_identity_provenance pointing at upgrade-contract artifact. Re-running this backup proof against a different target requires updating target_revision + target_commit_sha to a fresh readback.
redaction_notes: All UUID-style identifiers in this artifact use 8-char prefixes only (no full UUID literal).

All credential-shaped substrings (the 14 REDACTION_FORBIDDEN_SUBSTRINGS items in validator design: PAPERCLIP_API_KEY followed by equals, BETTER_AUTH_SECRET followed by equals, POSTGRES_PASSWORD followed by equals, and similar key= shapes) are absent from this artifact body.
Historical full git SHA (60efa38f868e838e9af2e2168daf0c70afefb9e6) referenced only in upstream_diff.md and baseline.json historical_observed_git_commit_sha — never echoed in this backup proof.
.env secrets are NEVER captured or echoed. Backup of .env is hash-only by design (sha256sum, no content read).
